resolutions.researcher_notes: Youm7 (2020-01-11): Minister Tarek El Molla launches the 'رأس بكر / رأس غارب / أسيوط' (Ras Bakr/Ras Gharb/Asyut) butagas line, 155km, EGP 450m. PPC chairman Emad Abdel Qader (رئيس شركة أنابيب البترول) states the doubling used a parallel 12-inch (قطر 12 بوصة) line on both sector 1 (Ras Bakr/Ras Gharb, 25km) and sector 2 (Khashm El-Raqaba/New Asyut, 130km) -- directly confirms 12in diameter. Original ref (hotinformationonline.com) now 200s to a generic repurposed-domain homepage template with no article content (soft-404; no Wayback capture exists to fall back on), so not usable or kept alongside. Single new source -> tier medium, independent=false.

Same Youm7 article (2020-01-11): 'اعطي زير البترول شارة بدء تشغيل خط انابيب رأس بكر / رأس غارب / أسيوط بطول 155 كيلو متر وبتكلفة استثمارية 450 مليون جنيه' -- Minister gave the go-ahead to start operating the Ras Bakr/Ras Gharb/Asyut line, 155km, at an investment cost of EGP 450 million. Directly confirms Cost=450,000,000 EGP. Original ref (enterprise.press) returns 200 but the fetched static HTML is only the site's JS-shell navigation chrome with none of the article body reachable -- could not confirm it supports the value, so not used or kept alongside. Single source -> tier medium, independent=false.
